items.title: Meet the Man Utd and Man City Wags cheering their men on in fiery derby, from a friend of Molly-Mae to a supermodel
items.summary: BRAGGING rights are up for grabs in the Manchester derby this afternoon. Man Utd and Man City lock horns at Old Trafford on Super Sunday, which should prove to be a huge derby for both clubs. Michael Carrick's side are coming off the back of a thumping 4-0 win over Sabah in the Champions League....

items.title: Record crowd in US for Springboks vs All Blacks is World Cup 'appetiser'
items.summary: The captains of South Africa and New Zealand hoped Saturday's final Greatest Rivalry rugby Test, in front of almost 70,000 fans at NFL side Baltimore Ravens' stadium, would whet American appetites for the 2031 Rugby World Cup, which the United States will host.
